transitions.condition: VISCOSITY_OK AND PASTE_E_STOP_NC AND DebounceTime > TIME#0ms

entry_actions: VFD_RUN := FALSE unless refreshed TON Q is TRUE in output stage
accumulate runtime only if end-of-scan VFD_RUN is TRUE

timer_plan.name: TON_ViscosityDebounce
reset_conditions: any loss of permit requires full new DebounceTime qualification
timer_plan.notes: Call unconditionally outside CASE/IF. Elapsed is zero on the first eligible TRUE sample and Q becomes TRUE at elapsed >= DebounceTime.

timer_plan.name: RuntimeAccumulator
timer_plan.type: LTIME arithmetic, not a timer FB
timer_plan.PT: N/A; increment by TIME_TO_LTIME(CycleTime) only when end-of-scan VFD_RUN is TRUE
timer_plan.notes: PUMP_MAINT_DUE is the level comparison PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC >= LTIME#500h and is informational only.

priorities: Safety priority 1: PASTE_E_STOP_NC FALSE immediately forces VFD_RUN FALSE, clears debounce qualification, and resets incomplete debounce timing.
Safety priority 2: raw VISCOSITY_OK FALSE invalidates the viscosity condition immediately and forces VFD_RUN FALSE.
Operational priority 1: VFD_RUN may be TRUE only when PASTE_E_STOP_NC is TRUE, VISCOSITY_OK is TRUE, and the debounced viscosity qualification is valid.
Operational priority 2: any loss of permit requires a full new continuous DebounceTime qualification before VFD_RUN can be TRUE again.
Operational priority 3: accumulate PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC with CycleTime only while end-of-scan VFD_RUN is TRUE; preserve accumulated runtime while stopped.
Operational priority 4: PUMP_MAINT_DUE does not inhibit or override VFD_RUN or any safety permissive.
Execution priority: output assignments are unified after safety/state/timer processing; E-stop and raw viscosity gates are applied at the final output write.
scan_execution_order: 1. Edge sampling: sample VISCOSITY_OK, PASTE_E_STOP_NC, DebounceTime, and CycleTime once; update edge flags and previous-sample values without changing outputs.

2. Safety/reset priority and state transitions: first apply PASTE_E_STOP_NC FALSE or VISCOSITY_OK FALSE to force STOPPED and clear debounce qualification; then evaluate STOPPED/DEBOUNCING/RUNNING transitions using current sampled inputs and retained TON Q.

3. Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: call TON_ViscosityDebounce with IN := VISCOSITY_OK AND PASTE_E_STOP_NC and PT := DebounceTime; reset occurs automatically whenever IN is FALSE.

4. Unified output assignments: VFD_RUN := (State = RUNNING OR (State = DEBOUNCING AND TON_ViscosityDebounce.Q)) AND VISCOSITY_OK AND PASTE_E_STOP_NC; IF VFD_RUN THEN PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC := PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC + TIME_TO_LTIME(CycleTime); END_IF; PUMP_MAINT_DUE := PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC >= LTIME#500h; write all outputs once.
